at.step: Reveal: what this sandbox names but doesn't run, and why the two differ

items.item: A record validator (Pydantic), a DataFrame schema (Pandera), and a production data-quality scan (GX, Soda) check at three different points in a pipeline, not one point three different ways.

Pydantic v2's Rust core is measurably faster than Pydantic v1's pure-Python core on the identical record-validation task, confirmed by a real cross-version benchmark rather than taken only from the documentation's own speed claim.

Validating every record of a large batch one at a time, inside a per-row loop, instead of once as a vectorized batch check, is exactly the row-level-vs-batch-level cost gap this topic measures directly.

items.item: A schema checked at the boundary (this topic) is a different layer from governance tooling that catalogs and audits data quality across a whole organization (§13.3) — validation belongs at the boundary; governance belongs downstream of it.
